scope: Read-only ownership audit of a proposed compiler alias hint; no annotation or trial build.
decision: Reject restrict-this annotation: required disjointness is unproven.
finding: GameContexts allocates the entire Game/CPU/FPU object through malloc32 in HeapArena and resolves context addresses through checked guest mapping. Valid guest operands may therefore overlap native register/FPU fields.
whyNormalRaceNotProof: The leaf accepts generic guest addresses and9staticcallers includecomputedaddresses; normal race captures do not establish no-overlap for all valid inputs. Queued renderer pressure may invoke prior callbacks.
next: Inspect actual normal-path costs and retain valid Game/context aliasing plus fault/cancellation FPU state in any future candidate.
